statement: Source implementations enumerate IR mode 0x06 clustering and 0x07 image transfer, paged sensor register writes for resolution, exposure, gain, LEDs, flip, filtering and configuration finalization. Supported source-listed image sizes include 320 by 240, 160 by 120, 80 by 60, 40 by 30 and an Eden-only 20 by 15 format.
